a.lede: Man gets 18 months for AI scheme stealing $8M in music streaming royalties.
a.title: Fraudster jailed for using 10K bots and AI songs to outstream Taylor Swift

b.lede: The first-ever criminal case involving AI-assisted music streaming fraud has concluded, with an American citizen facing 18 months behind bars and an $8M fine.
b.title: American jailed for commanding 10,000 bots to stream his own AI-generated songs
